I’m waking up early again and everything and my morning block of studying goes great but i just end up losing momentum in the afternoon. i planned a proper study schedule (i always do this and it works for me to visualise or i get scatterbrained), i followed it for like two days and went off track again. i feel like i just don’t have the willpower anymore? i need to go back to studying 8 or more hours but im barely hitting 4 these days
